q: Angel said, “I bought a pen yesterday.”
o: Angel said that she had bought a pen the day before
Angel said that I had bought a pen the day before
Angel said that she bought a pen the day before
Angel said that she has bought a pen the day before
e: Past indefinite (bought) reporting verb past হলে past perfect (had bought) হয়, আর yesterday বদলে the day before হয়। I বদলে বক্তা Angel অনুযায়ী she হয়। সঠিক রূপ: Angel said that she had bought a pen the day before। I রেখে দিলে person ভুল, ‘bought’ রেখে দিলে কাল বদলানো হয়নি, আর ‘has bought’ present perfect, যা past reporting verb-এর সাথে চলে না।

q: Choose the correct direct speech of: 'He asked me if I could lend him some money.'
o: He said to me, "If I can lend him some money."
He said to me, "Can you lend me some money?"
He said to me, "Could I lend you some money?"
He said to me, "You can lend me some money."
e:
asked ... if বাক্যটি Yes/No Question-এর Indirect রূপ। Direct করতে প্রশ্নবোধক গঠন ফিরিয়ে আনা হয়, if উঠে যায় এবং Auxiliary আগে বসে। could হয় can, me (শ্রোতা) হয় you, আর him হয় me, ফলে Can you lend me some money?
মনে রাখুন:
Indirect-এ প্রশ্নচিহ্ন থাকে না; Direct-এ প্রশ্নচিহ্ন বসে।

q: The player said, "Alas! We have lost the final match." [indirect]
o: The player exclaimed sorrowfully that we have lost the final match
The player exclaimed with sorrow that they had lost the final match.
The player exclaimed with sorrow that they have lost the final match
The player said with grief that they lost the final match.

q: Choose the correct indirect speech: Rina said, "I saw him here yesterday."
o: Rina said that she saw him here yesterday.
Rina said that she had seen him here the previous day.
Rina said that she had seen him there the previous day.
Rina said that I had seen him there yesterday.
e:
Reported Speech-এ Past Simple হয় Past Perfect। আবার here হয় there, আর yesterday হয় the previous day। I, বক্তা Rina হওয়ায়, হয় she। সবকটি পরিবর্তন একসঙ্গে ঘটলে তবেই বাক্য শুদ্ধ হয়।
মনে রাখুন:
last night → the previous night; next week → the following week; ago → before।

q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said to me, "Where did you buy this book?"
o: He asked me where I had bought that book.
He asked me where did I buy this book.
He asked me where I bought this book.
He asked me that where I had bought that book.
e:
Wh-question-এর Indirect রূপে ক্রিয়ার ক্রম স্বাভাবিক বাক্যের মতো হয় (Subject + Verb), প্রশ্নবোধক ক্রম থাকে না। did buy হয় had bought, you হয় I, আর this হয় that। কোনো that যুক্ত হয় না, Wh-word-ই সংযোজক।
মনে রাখুন:
asked + wh-word + S + V (প্রশ্নচিহ্ন ছাড়া)।
